# nemau_instance (Resource)

A compute instance.

The size is either `flavor_id` or the three `vcpus`, `ram_mb` and `disk_gb` values: the API rejects a partial custom size. `flavor_id` additionally requires the `compute-flavors` organization feature.

An instance cannot be destroyed while a volume is attached: the platform refuses, because the volume's disk would be destroyed with it. Reference the instance from the `nemau_volume_attachment` (`instance_id = nemau_instance.<name>.id`) and Terraform detaches the volume first.

The size (`vcpus`, `ram_mb`, `disk_gb`), the security groups, the power state (`started`) and the `backup_policy` change in place. The image, flavor, network, service level, SSH key and `user_data` force a replacement.

Only the system disk is backed up. Block volumes attached to the instance are not, and a database needs its own dump for a consistent copy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_instance" "web" {
  name     = "web"
  image_id = one(data.nemau_images.ubuntu.images).id

  # A custom size. With the compute-flavors organization feature, flavor_id
  # can replace these three arguments.
  vcpus   = 2
  ram_mb  = 4096
  disk_gb = 40

  network_id         = nemau_network.app.id
  security_group_ids = [nemau_security_group.web.id]
  key_name           = nemau_keypair.deploy.name

  # The instance takes an address in the subnet, and no argument references
  # it, so the dependency is declared.
  depends_on = [nemau_subnet.app]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `image_id` (String) Image to boot. See the `nemau_images` data source.
- `name` (String) Instance name. Changes in place.

### Optional

- `backup_policy` (Block, Optional) Scheduled snapshots of the system disk. Each one is deleted when its `retention_days` have passed. Remove the block to stop scheduled backups: the snapshots already taken keep their expiry. Manual snapshots never expire. Changes in place; a change sends the whole policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--backup_policy))
- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB (10-5000). Grown online: raising it alone leaves the instance running. A disk never shrinks.
- `flavor_id` (String) Flavor id. Mutually exclusive with the custom size. See the `nemau_flavors` data source.
- `key_name` (String) Name of the SSH keypair injected at boot.
- `network_id` (String) Id of the network to attach at boot.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory in MB (1024-262144). Changes in place, but the instance is power-cycled to apply it.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security groups applied to the instance. A change replaces the existing groups; an empty set removes all filtering without destroying the instance.
- `service_level` (String) `99.9%` (covered by the availability SLA, the default) or `best-effort` (no SLA, billed at a lower rate). Changing it replaces the instance.
- `started` (Boolean) Desired power state. Setting `false` stops the instance without destroying it.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) cloud-init document run at the instance's first boot: it must start with `#cloud-config`, `#!` or a MIME multipart header, be UTF-8 without NUL bytes, and be at most 16 KiB. The platform seals it, never returns it, and runs it only at creation, so a change forces a replacement. The state keeps the value from the configuration, in clear: protect the state file. When the platform reports a different SHA-256 (the instance was made with another document, outside Terraform), the value is dropped from the state, which plans a replacement. After `terraform import` the value is unknown: the state holds `null`, and a configuration that sets `user_data` then plans a replacement.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs (1-64). Changes in place, but the instance is power-cycled to apply it.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (List of String) Known IP addresses. Empty until the guest has reported its network configuration.
- `id` (String) Instance id.
- `status` (String) Reported status: running, stopped, paused or pending.

<a id="nestedblock--backup_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_policy`

Required:

- `retention_days` (Number) Days each scheduled snapshot is kept, 1 to 35.
- `schedule` (String) `daily` or `weekly`. To stop backups, remove the block rather than setting `none`.

Optional:

- `hour` (Number) UTC hour the backup starts, 0 to 23. Defaults to `2`.
- `weekday` (Number) Day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday). Only `weekly` uses it; the platform ignores it for `daily`. Defaults to `0`.

## Import

```shell
# An instance imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_instance.web 6f1d2c3b-8a4e-4f7d-9b20-5e3c1a7d9f42
```
